lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the orphaned recycle watcher by persisting its PID to .claude/.cam-watcher.pid (WATCHER_PID_FILE in sidecar-pid.ts), writing it immediately after spawn in run.ts, and adding a watcher kill step to performStop in stop.ts (mirrors the sidecar kill step: read pid, probe liveness, SIGTERM if alive, always remove file). New test: test/stop-watcher-kill.test.ts (3 cases: absent, dead, alive). Also added removeWatcherPidIfExists call to the SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup handler in run.ts. All 2782 tests pass. Check prd.json for the next story after US-R1-001 (all other stories are passes:true, review verdict is FIXES_PENDING:1 -- now addressed; next step is re-review).
